rows.summary: Fix greet() to return 'hello ' instead of 'helo ' so the test passes.
Fix the loop condition in sumTo so that it includes n in the sum (i <= n instead of i < n), making sumTo(5) return 15 instead of 10.
Fix add function to return sum instead of difference so add(2,3) returns 5.
Change > to >= so isAdult(18) returns true (age of majority).
Add missing return statement so total([1,2,3]) returns the sum instead of undefined.
Fix default tax rate from 20% to 25% so withTax(100) returns 125.
Make sameName compare names case-insensitively by lowercasing both before equality check.
Fix last() to return the actual last element instead of undefined by using length-1 index.
Fix ratio(x, y) to compute x/y (via divide) instead of y/x, so ratio(10,4) returns 2.5.
Fix capitalize to use slice(1) instead of slice(2) so it includes the second character.
